Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You turn on your heel, breathing out as the air whirls outward with you.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Fortitude
Target / range / shape
Every other adjacent creature.
Duration
Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic / Attack

Turn with the wind at your heels. Make one roll using the net Boons or Banes least favorable to you among the targets; apply the result to all of them.

Weak
3 physical damage and push 1.
Standard
4 physical damage and push 2.
Strong
6 physical damage and push 2; you may move 2 squares without provoking afterward.
